_about: Delete check fixtures for the accessibility job (#2140), one for every partner in partners.json (partner-fixtures.test.ts holds that). Each entry is the route's inputs (the SQL check's answer, the ledger's counts, the organization's workflows and the sub-account IDs) and the answer the real route gives for them, which partners-fixtures-contract.test.ts holds. Counts, workflow ids, names and updated_at, and which workflows name each partner by id, were read from production on 2026-10-16, read only; the ledger counts and the reduced definitions are synthetic. Tripoint is blocked by its sales; the others can be deleted.
